$comment: The batteries-included model pack for the app-store builds.
WHY THIS EXISTS. A store build cannot download executable code, but model
weights and knowledge catalogs are DATA and stay legal to ship or fetch.
Shipping them in the package is nonetheless the deliberate choice: the
store CDN carries the bandwidth (Apple and Microsoft both serve multi-GB
packages at no egress cost to us), a fresh install answers its first
prompt, speaks, and transcribes with nothing downloaded, and no first-run
trip to Hugging Face is required for the app to be useful.
WHAT GOES IN. Enough for a complete, offline first boot on a low-end
machine — a small chat model, speech-to-text, and text-to-speech. Not the
best model available: the point is that the app works before the user has
chosen anything. Larger models stay a download the user opts into.
SHA PINS ARE MANDATORY. Every entry is verified byte-for-byte before it is
staged, and an all-zero sha is a hard build error rather than a warning —
the same rule node-version.ts and pnpm-version.ts follow. A store package
is signed and reviewed; an unpinned blob inside one is not something that
can be walked back after the fact.
DELTA-FRIENDLINESS. Keep `targetPath` stable across releases. Both stores
ship differential updates, and a weight file at a stable path with
unchanged bytes is one an app update does not re-ship. Bump `packVersion`
only when the CONTENTS change, independently of the app version.
